newsitem.title: CHINA: Second Tibet company to issue A shares.
newsitem.headline: Second Tibet company to issue A shares.

text.p: A second Tibet-based company will issue shares on the Shanghai stock market, the China Securities newspaper said on Monday.

Tibet Jinzhu Company Ltd, a trading company, had received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 13.5 million A shares, which will later be listed on the Shanghai stock market, the newspaper said but gave no more details.
The first Tibet-based company, Tibet Shendi Co, issued 15 million A shares last week and was due to be listed in Shanghai shortly, exchange statements said earlier.
A total of 595,931 people applied to buy the shares of Tibet Shendi, with a success rate of 0.24316 percent, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
